summary: Repair paper uptime checks and backup validation without changing the frozen trading decision surface or existing accounts.
steps: Add bounded daemon/container/API readiness probes, durable status, cooldown, and an optional local notification adapter.
Permit recovery only for known existing paper containers; never submit orders or recreate runtime configuration.
Make brain snapshots atomic and fail closed on incomplete source or destination; protect valid retention on backup failure.
Add a fresh PostgreSQL custom-format backup with checksums and an explicitly isolated restore-verification command.
Add local scheduling templates and accurate recovery instructions; root installs only after review.
Verify behavior with mocked commands, synthetic brain fixtures, isolated test state, and a separately scoped restore rehearsal.
constraints: No strategy, frozen constants, trading account resets, or credential changes.
No production service restart or schedule installation by this worker.
No external notifications until the operator selects the delivery channel.
No destructive restore against the live database or live brain.
local_notification_default: macOS only, enabled in template after reviewed installation
